name: Picasso's Naturals

Photo 2 (Java coffee/tea board) is drink-only, excluded per rules. Skipped all vegetable-juice and smoothie listings (drinks). A couple of prices (Vegan Samosas piece pricing, one TV breakfast combo price) were too blurred to read and were omitted rather than guessed.
